correctness.rationale: The augmentation ideal J is exactly the nilpotent elements, since a nonzero scalar part makes an element a unit. Any substitutions into J define endomorphisms, and invertibility of the linear part makes the triangular map on 1, J/J² and J² invertible (the action on J² is g tensor g). To independently see linearization, average any section V→J over the cyclic group generated by f, transporting the section by f onto V by its quotient action; division by ell is valid and the averaged section still induces the identity on V. Its images give a change of generators making f linear. The centralizer of a linear representative consists exactly of linear parts preserving its eigenspaces and independent quadratic corrections intertwining g and g tensor g. Ordered input-output eigenvalue triples contribute r_alpha r_beta r_gamma precisely when gamma=alpha beta, giving H; orbit–stabilizer then gives the formula and the GL multiplicity labels cannot merge. Weak compositions, the lcm order, the ell=1 identity case, and the odd-characteristic ell=2 specialization follow. Independent ordered-word substitution replay `python3 /workspace/review_evidence/reproduce.py 3` checks every one of 314,928 automorphisms in d=2, q=3 directly and gives the three multiplicity counts 1, 972, 6561 (total 7534). The frozen checker itself actually compares aggregate weighted totals per parameter pair, not class-by-class counts as its RESULT.md says; the separate replay tests these three classes, and the general result rests on the proof.
residual_risks: The independent computation is for q=3, d=2, ell=2 only; the proof covers all stated split, characteristic-coprime cases. It does not address wild or nonsplit orders.

value.rationale: The natural torsion census asks for sizes of conjugacy classes in the full algebra-automorphism group, not merely their projected similarity types. The evaluated resonance tracks exactly which ordered words allow corrections to centralize a given linear part; this yields an explicit order-by-order enumeration uniformly in field, dimension and split order. Generic linearization alone does not supply these sizes. Neither the generic mechanism nor the worked dimension-two example in isolation carries the value decision.
residual_risks: The total is a finite explicit sum, not a product or a result for nonsplit or wild orders.
